notes.zh: 评注：灰色风暴只在游戏开局随机选中的一种L星团结局（概率与德萨努协和国、龙季、空星团并列）下出现；开门事件 distar.10950 随后发出隐藏的 graygoo.1，创建风暴国家与舰队，并每3600天增援一次（graygoo.3/4，隐藏）。
notes.en: Commentary: the Gray Tempest exists only when the game-start roll picked it among the four L-Cluster outcomes (Tempest 50 unless disruptive gameplay is blocked / empty 30 / dragons 30 / Dessanu 30). Opening the L-Gate (distar.10950) then fires hidden graygoo.1, which creates the Tempest country and fleets and reinforces every 3600 days (hidden graygoo.3/4). Sources: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1110-1135, 1367-1370; events/gray_goo_events.txt:11-279, 327-457.
